title: AI Fundamentals for 10X Productivity
tagline: Boost your personal and professional productivity tenfold.
description: Master the basics of AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and Midjourney. Learn prompt engineering, workflow automation, and how to integrate AI into your daily tasks.

faq.question: Do I need any prior AI or programming experience?
faq.answer: No. This course is designed for absolute beginners. We start from the fundamentals and gradually build up to advanced techniques. All you need is a laptop and an internet connection.

faq.question: What tools and platforms will we use during the course?
faq.answer: You will get hands-on experience with ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, and other leading AI tools. We also cover workflow automation platforms to help you integrate AI into your daily routine.

faq.question: Is the course live or pre-recorded?
faq.answer: All sessions are conducted live via Zoom with the instructor. Recordings are provided after each session so you can revisit the material at your own pace.

faq.question: Will I receive a certificate upon completion?
faq.answer: Yes. Upon successfully completing all modules and the final project, you will receive a KGF Bharat Certificate of Completion that you can add to your LinkedIn profile.
